bon-442.title: Rehearse failures before they occur
bon-442.summary: Chaos Studio releases workspaces and an AKS extension in general availability for hosting repeatable resilience experiments.
bon-442.impact: Allows you to check application recovery before a real incident.
bon-442.application: Test the loss of a zone or the crash of a pod in a controlled environment.
bon-442.technical: The spaces group together reusable resources and scenarios; The AKS extension reduces the permissions required to run experiments.

bon-443.title: Protects data also while it is processed
bon-443.summary: Azure expands its confidential computing with preview offerings for multiple GPUs, enclaves, containers, and cross-organization collaboration.
bon-443.impact: Opens options for working with sensitive information without trusting the entire runtime environment.
bon-443.application: Evaluate a shared data room between partners that does not expose your original data.
bon-443.technical: VR72, Confidential Enclaves, AKS Kata CoCo and Confidential Clean Room are in preview; review your requirements before designing production.

bon-444.title: Cobalt 200 reaches production
bon-444.summary: Cobalt 200 Arm virtual machines are now generally available, with new sizes geared toward memory and storage.
bon-444.impact: The CPU surrounding the models also matters for the efficiency of the agents.
bon-444.application: Compare an Arm-compatible load against your current infrastructure before migrating.
bon-444.technical: Microsoft announces up to 50% more CPU performance vs. Cobalt 100; The result depends on the load. Check region and Arm compatibility.

bon-446.title: Cloud operations with more context and agents
bon-446.summary: Azure combines new features from Monitor, Copilot and SRE Agent: health and natural language models available, along with new agent capabilities in preview.
bon-446.impact: Connect technical status to business impact to better prioritize incidents.
bon-446.application: Explore an assisted investigation that relates telemetry, dependencies and affected services.
bon-446.technical: Health models and Monitor's natural language capabilities are GA; spaces, skills and new SRE Agent features have preview availability.

bon-447.title: From agent to cluster: a common AI foundation
bon-447.summary: Microsoft connects Foundry with its own AKS clusters and introduces new pieces for running, isolating, and governing agents and inference.
bon-447.impact: It offers more control over infrastructure, data residency, and inference economics.
bon-447.application: Assess a deployment of open models in an AKS already governed by the organization.
bon-447.technical: Foundry on AKS, Agent Grid, Agent Sandbox and Flex nodes are in preview; Cobalt 200 is GA. Not all pieces have the same maturity.

bon-448.title: Azure Catalyst connects migration and modernization
bon-448.summary: Azure Catalyst brings together assisted discovery, planning, and execution to transform infrastructure, applications, and data between Azure and GitHub.
bon-448.impact: It helps to consider modernization as a connected process, not as isolated migrations.
bon-448.application: Identify dependencies of a legacy application and prepare reviewable modernization alternatives.
bon-448.technical: Catalyst and its agent are GA; Certain runtime features and scenarios, such as BizTalk to Logic Apps, remain in preview.

bon-449.title: First look at Windows Server 2028
bon-449.summary: Windows Server 2028 enters preview with advances in security, storage, management and enterprise AI inference.
bon-449.impact: It allows you to prepare the evolution of the data center without confusing a preview with an immediate migration recommendation.
bon-449.application: Create a lab to evaluate security and compatibility of existing applications.
bon-449.technical: The proposal includes hardened Server Core, post-quantum cryptography, NVMe, and hybrid AI scenarios. Validate requirements and support of each function.

bon-451.title: Cosmos DB strengthens search and development
bon-451.summary: Cosmos DB incorporates recovery enhancements, development tools and data protection, with GA and other components still in preview.
bon-451.impact: Reduces integration work by improving relevance, modeling and data retrieval.
bon-451.application: Test semantic searches and review the protection of an application with distributed data.
bon-451.technical: Shell, Rust SDK, semantic reranker and Backup are GA; VS Code assisted modeler is in preview. Review availability by capacity.

bon-452.title: DocumentDB extends to the hybrid environment
bon-452.summary: Azure DocumentDB adds more agile provisioning and tools, while preparing deployments with Arc, Azure Local, and finer permissions.
bon-452.impact: Provides new options for MongoDB-compatible loads with sovereignty needs.
bon-452.application: Explore development from VS Code and study where documents should reside.
bon-452.technical: The VS Code extension and M10–M30 provisioning are GA; Arc, Azure Local, and granular RBAC are in preview.

bon-453.title: HorizonDB: PostgreSQL for critical loads
bon-453.summary: Azure HorizonDB reaches general availability as a PostgreSQL-compatible managed database, with vector search and new AI features in preview.
bon-453.impact: Combine transactional needs with options for intelligent applications.
bon-453.application: Evaluate a PostgreSQL application that requires resiliency and information retrieval for AI.
bon-453.technical: Includes Entra ID, private endpoints and multi-zone replication; AI Functions, AI Pipelines and mirroring to Fabric are still in preview.

bon-454.title: Redis 8 and a kit to develop with agents
bon-454.summary: Azure Managed Redis presents in preview Redis 8 and an agent kit that reviews configurations and proposes improvements for the use of the service.
bon-454.impact: The memory and context of the agents become part of the data layout.
bon-454.application: Experiment with vector recovery or reuse of similar responses.
bon-454.technical: Redis 8 brings together JSON, search, time series, and vectors; kit recommendations should be evaluated by the developer.

bon-455.title: Azure SQL extends resiliency and local development
bon-455.summary: Azure SQL incorporates GA improvements in Managed Instance and a proposal in preview to develop with a local Azure SQL Database container.
bon-455.impact: It makes it easy to modernize SQL Server applications and test scenarios without always depending on the cloud.
bon-455.application: Review disaster recovery and test local development flow.
bon-455.technical: Managed Instance adds zone redundancy and flexible memory in supported configurations; MI link supports Always On groups with multiple bases.

bon-456.title: A control point for databases
bon-456.summary: Database Hub in Fabric is already GA and brings together database management; new SQL and PostgreSQL agents provide operational assistance in preview.
bon-456.impact: Reduces tool fragmentation for teams managing multiple engines and locations.
bon-456.application: Centralize the observation of the database park and study assisted recommendations.
bon-456.technical: Agents respect permits, approvals and auditing; Database Hub and the VS Code PostgreSQL extension are intended access points.

bon-457.title: Serverless PostgreSQL enters Fabric
bon-457.summary: Fabric HorizonDB is previewed to connect PostgreSQL applications, OneLake analytics, and backend services for Fabric apps.
bon-457.impact: You can simplify applications with variable demand and connected operational and analytical data.
bon-457.application: Prototype an application that queries transactional and analytical data together.
bon-457.technical: Includes pause and resume, translytical queries, mirroring and reverse ETL provided. It is different from the Azure HorizonDB service.

bon-458.title: More ways to modernize with PostgreSQL
bon-458.summary: Azure expands PostgreSQL migration, computing, and protection options, combining available advances with new previews.
bon-458.impact: It allows modernization paths to be compared without treating all scenarios as equivalent.
bon-458.application: Study a migration from Oracle or the evolution towards HorizonDB.
bon-458.technical: DMS for Oracle to PostgreSQL and towards HorizonDB is in preview; Cobalt 200 and AMD Confidential Protection v6 are listed as GA.

bon-459.title: From report to app in Power BI
bon-459.summary: Power BI Pro includes in preview the creation of data applications from Desktop with semantic models and natural language.
bon-459.impact: Brings data entry and actions closer to where they are analyzed.
bon-459.application: Test a planning application that updates records, rather than just displaying them.
bon-459.technical: The proposal is based on governed semantic models and Fabric Database capabilities. Review preview and licensing conditions.

bon-460.title: Rayfin and Fabric apps reach general availability
bon-460.summary: Rayfin and Fabric apps bring together backend, data, and governance to create enterprise applications connected to the Fabric ecosystem.
bon-460.impact: It reduces the pieces a team must assemble to go from an idea to an application.
bon-460.application: Design an internal application on already governed business data and definitions.
bon-460.technical: The platform supports SQL or Fabric HorizonDB and connection to semantic models, warehouses and lakehouses; check the maturity of the chosen backend.

bon-465.title: Upgrade agents with production evidence
bon-465.summary: Foundry connects evaluation, traces, annotation, optimization, and training to test whether changes actually improve an agent.
bon-465.impact: Replace intuitive adjustments with a measurable cycle of quality, cost and latency.
bon-465.application: Define a set of verified cases and compare configurations before deploying them.
bon-465.technical: Multi-turn evaluation, insights and Agent Optimizer are GA; Human annotation and new training options include features in preview.

bon-467.title: A specialized model for making decisions
bon-467.summary: Microsoft-Decision-1.1 is generally available for classification, routing, and action selection within defined limits.
bon-467.impact: It allows you to reserve the largest models for tasks that really require complex reasoning.
bon-467.application: Evaluate a request classifier that can abstain when confidence is insufficient.
bon-467.technical: Supports image input and confidence scores; Allowed actions and bypass thresholds must be defined in the application.

bon-468.title: More models, chosen according to the task
bon-468.summary: Foundry expands options for code, images, security, decisions and routing, with different availability by model and platform.
bon-468.impact: The selection of models depends on the balance between quality, cost and specialization.
bon-468.application: Prepare one assessment per task instead of adopting a single model for all uses.
bon-468.technical: MAI-Code-2 is GA on GitHub; other offers have public previews, private previews, or limited access to MDASH. Consult each card before planning.

bon-473.title: Copilot SDK 2.0 to integrate agents into your apps
bon-473.summary: Copilot SDK 2.0 comes to general availability with a native Rust runtime and focus on large-scale, multi-tenant enterprise applications.
bon-473.impact: Brings agent execution technology closer to your own applications.
bon-473.application: Evaluate an agent integrated into an existing application with its security limits.
bon-473.technical: The SDK supports six languages and uses the harness used by Microsoft and GitHub; review isolation and needs of each integration.

bon-478.title: FinOps to understand the value of AI
bon-478.summary: Agent 365 connects spend management and business analytics to observe costs, limits and results of AI services and agents.
bon-478.impact: It helps discuss the return of AI with data, not just token consumption.
bon-478.application: Define cost indicators per useful task before expanding a pilot.
bon-478.technical: Cost Management is in preview and Business Analytics in Frontier; Extensions announced for December should not be considered available today.

bon-479.title: Autopilot: work that continues between conversations
bon-479.summary: Autopilot begins to be deployed in Frontier as a long-term personal agent with its own identity, memory and tools.
bon-479.impact: Explore productivity based on delegating follow-up and recurring work.
bon-479.application: Try periodic monitoring with minimal permissions and explicit supervision.
bon-479.technical: It resides in the tenant, its actions are linked to the Agent ID and can be managed by administrators; It is not general availability.

bon-480.title: A managed runtime for publishing applications
bon-480.summary: Copilot Managed Runtime reaches general availability and connects hosting and governance with an optional Fabric data backend.
bon-480.impact: It separates the tool with which an app is created from the environment where it is executed and governed.
bon-480.application: Compare a managed publication for an app that requires data persistence.
bon-480.technical: Fabric can provide database, storage and APIs; The announcement also introduces Agents and Workflows and publishing from local tools.

bon-481.title: Workspaces bring together people, context and Copilot
bon-481.summary: Copilot Workspaces evolve Notebooks into shared spaces for documents, work in progress, and team context, within Frontier.
bon-481.impact: It can make it easier for a team to get up to speed and coordinate next steps.
bon-481.application: Organize the documents and decisions of an initiative in a shared space.
bon-481.technical: Autopilot integration is announced as future. Current access to Workspaces is through the Frontier program.

bon-482.title: CRM and ERP come to the Copilot flow
bon-482.summary: Dynamics 365 Sales and ERP plugins are already GA to bring commercial, financial and operational tasks closer to Copilot.
bon-482.impact: Reduces tool changes when preparing accounts or managing business processes.
bon-482.application: Explore the preparation of a business meeting or an assisted purchasing process.
bon-482.technical: Sales incorporates opportunity context; ERP integrates tasks with Copilot Cowork and Excel. Review permissions and conditions of each application.

bon-483.title: Create applications with natural language and controls
bon-483.summary: Copilot Code allows you to create applications in Frontier, with sandboxes and compatible app publishing through Copilot Managed Runtime.
bon-483.impact: Brings the creation of tools closer to business teams while maintaining a governance role for IT.
bon-483.application: Prototype a team tracker and review its data access before sharing it.
bon-483.technical: The local sandbox is available on Windows; macOS is announced later. General availability of Copilot Code is announced for December.

bon-484.title: Copilot Home connects ask, delegate and create
bon-484.summary: Home brings together Chat and Cowork, incorporates Office and expands task routing with GA, Frontier and previews features.
bon-484.impact: It allows you to move from a conversation to more elaborate work without losing context.
bon-484.application: Compare when to resolve a query in Chat and when to delegate a flow in Cowork.
bon-484.technical: Office on Copilot and recommendations to switch to Cowork are GA; other functions, such as declarative agents, have more restricted access.

bon-485.title: Activate expands assisted migration to ERP
bon-485.summary: Dynamics 365 Activate extends its reach to SAP ECC with discovery, requirements, configuration and migration, through a progressive deployment.
bon-485.impact: Helps analyze which processes and integrations should be moved, simplified or redesigned.
bon-485.application: Evaluate the scope of an ERP modernization before committing to a project.
bon-485.technical: CRM migration from Salesforce is GA; ERP functions are deployed over the following weeks and require human validation.

bon-486.title: Salesforce connects with Copilot, Teams and Fabric
bon-486.summary: Microsoft and Salesforce announce new business context, collaboration, and data integrations with varying availability states.
bon-486.impact: It allows you to bring context from the client to the tools where the team already works.
bon-486.application: Explore business queries in Copilot while respecting existing Salesforce permissions.
bon-486.technical: Salesforce on Copilot is in preview, Sales Cloud on Teams is in pilot, and Data Federation with OneLake is GA. They are not a single release.

bon-487.title: Today prepares priorities and next steps
bon-487.summary: Today is announced in a private Frontier preview to gather priorities and prepare drafts and actions that the user reviews and approves.
bon-487.impact: Explore a more proactive day, without eliminating people's approval.
bon-487.application: Evaluate a daily briefing and measure if it reduces preparation time.
bon-487.technical: Today Brief is included with Microsoft 365 Copilot; Recurring Today Feed updates require Copilot credits per announcement.

bon-492.title: The browser also governs working with agents
bon-492.summary: Edge for Business adds flow recording and agent navigation in preview, along with extension risk inventory and GA.
bon-492.impact: It places the browser as a control point for productivity, identity and security.
bon-492.application: Review installed extensions and rehearse a repeatable Cowork flow with IT control.
bon-492.technical: Skills recorder and managed agent browsing are in preview; Extension safety is GA and Extension leak control remains in preview.

bon-497.title: Microsoft IQ connects context and continuous improvement
bon-497.summary: Microsoft IQ is presented as an enterprise platform to bring together organizational knowledge and learning from application and agent experience.
bon-497.impact: It helps understand how the different IQ pieces fit into an AI strategy.
bon-497.application: Map what sources and metrics a use case needs before choosing tools.
bon-497.technical: The platform is announced GA and without new SKU; This does not imply that all its components or consumer services are free or GA.

bon-499.title: Turn business experience into reusable context
bon-499.summary: Microsoft IQ connects Work, Fabric, Foundry, and Web IQ with reusable tools, skills, and agents; business plugins add scenario guidance in Frontier.
bon-499.impact: You can prevent each team from rebuilding the same instructions and integrations.
bon-499.application: Define a process guide with authorized sources and those responsible for maintenance.
bon-499.technical: Access to context and reusable blocks is GA; business plugins with managed hierarchy have Frontier availability.

bon-501.title: Foundry IQ goes deeper into documents and relationships
bon-501.summary: Foundry IQ extends retrieval with knowledge graphs and Microsoft-Retriever-1 in preview, while SharePoint indexed feed reaches GA.
bon-501.impact: Improves options for basing responses on organizational information.
bon-501.application: Evaluate questions that require connecting clauses, suppliers and documents with citations.
bon-501.technical: Combines lexical, vector and hybrid search; Access to SharePoint respects origin permissions. New serverless graphs and resources are still in preview.

bon-503.title: Fabric IQ brings the meaning of data to more tools
bon-503.summary: Fabric IQ expands its integrations to connect governed data and business context with Copilot, third-party applications and experiences.
bon-503.impact: Ensure that people and agents use consistent definitions of metrics and rules.
bon-503.application: Test business questions on a semantic model validated by those responsible.
bon-503.technical: GA integrations coexist with previews for Excel, ontologies in GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT and Claude connectors. Verify each destination.

bon-505.title: Web IQ opens access to the web context
bon-505.summary: Web IQ is now GA for Azure customers, with Auto, Auto Advanced and Scopes modes to retrieve and scope external information.
bon-505.impact: It allows you to complement business knowledge with recent information and controlled sources.
bon-505.application: Compare external recovery with allowed domains for an informational wizard.
bon-505.technical: Auto brings together content categories; Auto Advanced iterates queries and Scopes allows you to include or exclude URLs, domains and routes.

bon-507.title: Work IQ expands context, actions and control
bon-507.summary: Work IQ extends recovery and available actions, and adds preview capabilities to respond to events and apply more granular controls.
bon-507.impact: It brings together agents who act within the context of work, with new supervision needs.
bon-507.application: Study an event-based flow with approvals before executing sensitive actions.
bon-507.technical: Recovery and new actions are GA; listen and expanded controls are preview. Future integrations should be checked separately.

bon-509.title: From real result to a better agent
bon-509.summary: Microsoft IQ connects production signals with Agent Optimizer and model training to improve applications under team-defined criteria.
bon-509.impact: It focuses on the cost and quality per result achieved, not only on isolated responses.
bon-509.application: Measure a task from start to finish and approve changes only if they improve the baseline.
bon-509.technical: Settings can be optimized before resorting to training; Programmed Training is in preview and offers control over compatible models.

bon-514.title: The agent's risk changes as he works
bon-514.summary: Dynamic Agent Risk arrives in preview to combine identity, data, devices and execution signals into an agent risk assessment.
bon-514.impact: Helps replace isolated views with more contextual prioritization.
bon-514.application: Explore how to incorporate execution signals into agent inventory and review.
bon-514.technical: Integrates context of exposure and impact; Partner signals contribute to a unified evaluation calculated by Microsoft.

bon-515.title: More basic visibility into agent usage
bon-515.summary: Microsoft expands GA access to agent activity and usage metrics without requiring Agent 365 for all basic visibility.
bon-515.impact: Makes it easier to understand adoption before deciding on additional government investments.
bon-515.application: Review active users, sessions and exceptions as a starting point for inventory.
bon-515.technical: Not equivalent to all unlicensed features: advanced governance and security maintain requirements. Viva Insights requires at least 50 assigned Copilot licenses.

bon-516.title: Govern agents, skills and tools from a common view
bon-516.summary: Agent 365 expands plugin governance, MCP tools and agents with GA capabilities, previews and an action center announced for later.
bon-516.impact: The inventory needs to also include tools and dependencies, not just agents.
bon-516.application: Identify unowned agents and review who can use each plugin.
bon-516.technical: Plugins and skills governance is GA; MCP gateway support and other capabilities are in preview. Action Center is scheduled for private preview in December.

bon-517.title: Measure where investing in agents adds value
bon-517.summary: Agent 365 Business Analytics offers a view of costs and results for Microsoft and third-party agents in Frontier Preview.
bon-517.impact: It connects investment decisions with the observed utility of the agents.
bon-517.application: Define indicators of success and efficiency to compare AI initiatives.
bon-517.technical: The announcement places Business Analytics in Frontier preview; Confirm eligibility and cost coverage before creating a scorecard.

bon-519.title: MDASH seeks better validated code findings
bon-519.summary: Codename MDASH is in preview for eligible organizations with agent-based code analysis, validation of findings, and improvements for large repositories.
bon-519.impact: Seeks to reduce time spent reviewing low-quality results.
bon-519.application: Evaluate the service only on authorized repositories and with review of the results.
bon-519.technical: The flow combines identification, analysis, discussion between agents and reproduction when possible; Model coverage evolves with evaluations.

bon-521.title: An integrated SOC and new temporary defenses
bon-521.summary: The core capabilities of the Integrated SOC are GA; SIEM breadth and vulnerability shielding are presented in preview.
bon-521.impact: It connects detection and response, with temporary measures while a definitive correction is applied.
bon-521.application: Review how to coordinate telemetry, investigation and remediation in the SOC.
bon-521.technical: Shielding is not a substitute for patching: it applies temporary controls against active attacks. The 90-day Defender retention cited is from the preview.

bon-522.title: Defender protects local agents while they are running
bon-522.summary: Defender extends protection on Windows for supported local agents, with audit or blocking modes and differentiated coverage by tool.
bon-522.impact: Helps limit the risk of malicious instructions hidden in processed content.
bon-522.application: Start in Audit and review the impact before activating locks.
bon-522.technical: The advertised protections are GA for specific tools; Defender for Endpoint P2 is indicated. Verify native or network coverage according to agent.

bon-523.title: More context for emerging and zero-day threats
bon-523.summary: Defender previews new labels, views, warnings, and protection validation for rapidly evolving threats.
bon-523.impact: It allows prioritizing research according to the real context of the organization.
bon-523.application: Review exposure by sector and region and validate relevant protections.
bon-523.technical: The experience links threat analytics with Perception's protection playbook; confirm access to the preview and intelligence sources.

bon-524.title: Reduces the risk of on-premises systems
bon-524.summary: Microsoft announces an initiative to support Exchange, SharePoint and Skype for Business Server, combining hardening, migration and progressive protections.
bon-524.impact: Recognize that some systems will remain local and need a foundation of security maintained.
bon-524.application: Inventory versions, apply updates, and check recovery plans.
bon-524.technical: Baseline Security Mode and future capabilities have variable availability by product; Don't assume that the entire program is already deployed.

bon-526.title: Entra extends identity and access to the world of agents
bon-526.summary: Entra incorporates Agent ID for new scenarios, conditional access plans and recovery and governance improvements between tenants, mostly in preview.
bon-526.impact: The identity of agents requires distinguishing their actions from those of people.
bon-526.application: Review a permissions and traceability model for local and cloud agents.
bon-526.technical: Microsoft MCP Server for Enterprise is GA; Agent ID discovered, new credentials and Backup and Recovery Premium announced in preview.

bon-527.title: Measurable plans to prepare for AI security
bon-527.summary: AI Readiness Initiatives are announced for preview in January, with roadmaps on vulnerabilities, authentication and agent governance.
bon-527.impact: It proposes measuring exposure reduction with evidence from the tenant, not just task lists.
bon-527.application: Prepare responsible parties and metrics for patching and phishing-resistant authentication.
bon-527.technical: It is a future availability, not a preview open today. The initiatives align with Secure Now and Perception and maintain administrator control.

bon-529.title: Intune limits what local agents can do
bon-529.summary: Intune previews discovery and policies for local agents, connecting device compliance, identity, and isolation.
bon-529.impact: Helps adopt agents without losing visibility over managed teams.
bon-529.application: Prepare an inventory of approved agents and evaluate policies in a pilot group.
bon-529.technical: Combines Agent 365, Conditional Access, Microsoft Execution Containers, and Global Secure Access for execution and network boundaries.

bon-531.title: Perception brings specialized agents to security work
bon-531.summary: Microsoft Perception reaches GA for already announced agents and playbooks and expands research, third-party coverage and other features with specific availability.
bon-531.impact: It can help organize repetitive security tasks and prioritize human work.
bon-531.application: Evaluate a triage playbook on your own alerts with analyst supervision.
bon-531.technical: Specialized agents collaborate on flows; Web App Pen Test Agent remains in preview and should only be used with express permission.

bon-533.title: Purview expands data protection against agents
bon-533.summary: Purview previews improved classification and tagging, new Copilot protections, and controls for Windows endpoint agents.
bon-533.impact: Ensure that protection does not depend solely on all files being labeled.
bon-533.application: Review Copilot and agent access to sensitive data with data loss policies.
bon-533.technical: The ad includes grounding protection and coverage of attachments, links and text; validate scenarios and scope of each control in preview.

bon-538.title: Copilot in Windows helps with files and diagnostics
bon-538.summary: Windows prepares in preview file management in natural language, PC diagnosis and access to Copilot from the new search.
bon-538.impact: Brings support closer to the team's local context and common support tasks.
bon-538.application: Test organization of non-sensitive files and compare diagnostic recommendations.
bon-538.technical: Access from Search requires opt-in and supports management by IT policy. Advertised capabilities should not be treated as GA.

bon-539.title: Windows 365 improves connection and management
bon-539.summary: Windows 365 combines GA previews of Direct Stream and redirects with assisted management previews and access protection for Cloud PCs.
bon-539.impact: The cloud desktop experience depends on both connectivity and its management.
bon-539.application: Evaluate session quality and clipboard restrictions based on connection confidence.
bon-539.technical: Admin assistant and Windows MAM are in preview; GPU improvements with NVIDIA are announced for next year in specific regions.

bon-540.title: Windows and Intune move towards results-based management
bon-540.summary: Windows and Intune combine a GA endpoint security platform with new previews of core protection, declarative management, and reliability.
bon-540.impact: It seeks to maintain the desired configuration and give IT control over system changes.
bon-540.application: Prepare a pilot of reliability policies and metrics before extending new experiences.
bon-540.technical: Endpoint Security Platform is GA; Baseline protection, experience controls, and various Autopatch improvements are announced in private previews.

bon-541.title: Cloud PCs as a workspace for agents
bon-541.summary: Windows 365 for Agents expands its connections with Copilot Studio and announces Foundry integration and Cloud PC persistence in different preview programs.
bon-541.impact: Opens an avenue of automation for legacy applications without APIs.
bon-541.application: Study a computer usage flow on an authorized testing application.
bon-541.technical: Includes eligibility for Copilot Credits; Foundry MCP announced for next year and persistent Cloud PCs in Frontier preview.

bon-542.title: More options to run local and hybrid AI
bon-542.summary: Windows expands model execution on Cloud PCs and announces AVD Hybrid in Windows Server 2025 in private preview.
bon-542.impact: Allows you to compare execution locations based on scenario control, resources, and economics.
bon-542.application: Measure a compatible model on a sized Cloud PC before choosing a platform.
bon-542.technical: Cloud PCs with up to 32 vCPUs and GPU options are GA; AVD Hybrid is in private preview. Foundry Local requires supported models and resources.

bon-543.title: More precise limits for agents in Windows
bon-543.summary: Windows introduces new process, network and identity controls in preview; learning and permissive modes are already GA.
bon-543.impact: It helps establish what an agent can communicate, reach, or impersonate on a device.
bon-543.application: Observe an agent's legitimate communications first before imposing restrictions.
bon-543.technical: COM and IPC controls and granular policies do not share state with learning modes. Review each capability and its deployment phase.
